name: MSc Physics Major Project - 1
description: To take up, understand, analyse, a challenging problem in different branches of physics namely theoretical physics, condensed matter theory and experiment, high energy physics, optics and photonics, plasma physics etc., and to train students for a research career in different branches of physics. Improve communication and presentation skills to a broad audience. Improve scientific writing skills in the form of project reports. The project is to be done under the guidance of a faculty member at the department of physics, IIT Delhi only.
